verdict.rationale: Docusign's own product pages describe several in-product AI insight and suggestion features. These include AI-generated agreement summaries and Q&A for signers, AI-Assisted Review that flags risky language and suggests redlines against playbooks, CLM AI that flags non-compliant clauses and suggests approved language, and AI that auto-suggests fields based on detected agreement type. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these AI features work as claimed, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing-page claims (e.g., the scope of the 'find, analyze, and act on agreements' insights across a user's agreement data).
